GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2021-04-19T05:13:54Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: [QST] Queston about row number limit in cuDF dataframe
Description: Dear cuDF developers,

I am using Dask to load in some parquet data as a dask-cudf dataframe. When I use `.compute()` to convert from dask-cudf back to cuDF (I need some functions that aren't supported in dask-cudf) I am encountering this error:

```
RuntimeError: cuDF failure at: ../src/copying/concatenate.cu:365: Total number of concatenated rows exceeds size_type range
```

My dataframe has 27 million rows which seems... large but maybe still reasonable? What is the row limit? Is there any way I can increase this limit? 

If I can provide more info please let me know.

Thank you very much,
Laurie
